results.title: TRiSM for Agentic AI: A Review of Trust, Risk, and Security ... - arXiv
results.content: We then adapt and extend the AI TRiSM framework for Agentic AI, structured around four key pillars:  Explainability, ModelOps, Security, Privacy and Governance, each contextualized to the challenges of multi-agent LLM systems. The scope of this paper is confined to LLM based Agentic AI systems and AMAS 333Throughout this paper, *AMAS* designates multi-agent systems built on LLMs. Agentic AI research has largely centered on agent modeling, planning, and task coordination, while comparatively overlooking critical dimensions such as adversarial robustness, lifecycle governance, and system-level explainability. Studies that explicitly discuss  Agentic AI, Multi-Agents, or LLM-powered AI systems in the context of at least one TRiSM dimension: trust, risk, security, governance, explainability, or privacy. We propose a taxonomy of risks associated with AMAS, categorizing them into four primary classes: adversarial attacks, data leakage, agent collusion, and emergent behaviors, as shown in Figure 4 ‣ TRiSM for Agentic AI: A Review of Trust, Risk, and Security Management in LLM-based Agentic Multi-Agent Systems").
